query: Plan a small change to the errs package in src/common/errs: let an error carry an optional retry-after hint, so a caller that sees Retryable(err) can also ask how long to wait. It needs a Builder method, a lookup function beside Retryable that follows the same outermost-wins rule, tests, and a mention in the package README. Do not ask questions. Where you would ask, state the question and its options, then stop.
expected_behavior: Exactly one new docs/plans/*-plan.md exists with artifact_contract: flowseer-plan/v2 in its frontmatter.
A .state.json beside the plan records status planned.
The plan has a ### U1. unit heading.
Every unit carries a Files: line and an After: line.
The plan has a Waves: line.
verify check-prose reports the plan clean.
next plan-queue lists the plan as ready or replan.
Every changed path is under docs/plans/.
